CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES
  MONDAY, JULY 8, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  4TH FLOOR, QUEEN MARY CONFERENCE ROOM, 1:00 PM

Robyn Gordon-Peterson, President  Erik Frost Hollins, Commissioner
Jose Osuna, Vice President  Joen Garnica, Commissioner
  Victoria Love, Commissioner

Christina Pizarro Winting, Executive Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 1:04 PM, President Gordon-Peterson called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Garnica, Love, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson

 Commissioners Absent: Frost Hollins

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 Commissioner Love led the Pledge of Allegiance.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 There was no public comment.

 CLOSED SESSION

 1.  24-54127  Closed Session – Executive Director’s Performance Evaluation (Pursuant to
  paragraph (b) (1) of Section 54957 of California Government Code).

  This Agenda Item was received and filed.

  At 1:06 PM, there being no objection, President Gordon-Peterson recessed to
  Closed Session.

  At 1:15 PM, President Gordon-Peterson reconvened the meeting.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 2.  24-54128  Recommendation to adopt a salary range for the Executive Director of Civil Service
  and refer to City Council for consideration and approval and approve merit

  increase for the Executive Director.

  A motion was made by Vice President Osuna, seconded by
  Commissioner Love, to approve recommendation, as amended, to
  approve the merit increase for the Executive Director at the 7% level;
  adopt the salary range of $220,000 - $275,000 per year for the Executive
  Director of Civil Service; and make the merit increase retroactive to
  January 1, 2024. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Garnica, Love, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Frost Hollins

PUBLIC COMMENT

There was no public comment.

ADJOURNMENT

At 1:17 PM, there being no objection, President Gordon-Peterson declared the meeting adjourned.
